description: Huntsville, A.L. – Today, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce announced its endorsement of Dale Strong (R) to represent Alabama’s Fifth Congressional District. The Chamber endorses pro-business candidates for federal office who will vigorously support public policy that will advance economic growth, create jobs, and promote fiscal responsibility.Read the full release here.

title: U.S. Chamber Endorses Dale Strong for Alabama’s 5th Congressional District
